title: a16z Podcast: Nootropics and the Best Version of Your Brain, Yourself

reader_summary.source_label: From the episode notes — transcript not yet available
reader_summary.headline: What if you could bring the best version of yourself to everything you do everyday?
reader_summary.overview: What if you could bring the best version of yourself to everything you do everyday? What if you could get the most out of your mind and brain -- or more scientifically. The promise of nootropics or cognitive enhancers is to help us work better and more productively (for example, through more stamina and working memory).
